d: PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen won the singles titles at the Hylo Open in Germany, but their European campaign came amid a funding controversy. The Indian Express has learnt that the Sports Authority of India (SAI) declined to fund the Indian contingent's four-tournament European tour after the Badminton Association of India (BAI) allegedly failed to meet the submission deadline. While SAI denies that the decision was linked to performance, several players had to bear their own expenses, and some competed without coaches. We look at what happened, why funding was withheld and how the shuttlers…
